source_attribution.author: Malcolm Hoong Wai Chen
source_attribution.title: Abstract regular polytopes of G2(q) in even characteristic
used_locations: Section 2: seven-dimensional row model, fixed y4 and invariant bilinear form
Section 3: parameter omega, zeta, lambda and displayed five generators
Theorem 1.1: imported assertion that the five original generators form a C-string generating G2(q)
source_attribution.parameter_conditions: q is an even prime power greater than two; omega generates F_(q^2)^*; zeta=omega^(q-1) has order q+1; lambda=zeta+zeta^(-1) lies in F_q and is neither zero nor one.
source_attribution.generation_and_C_string_property: Imported from Chen Theorem 1.1, not reproved.
source_attribution.row_column_scope: The source boundary example uses rows. The rest uses columns. Entire representations use the contragredient g -> rho_row(g^-1)^T; plain transpose agrees on the involution marks only.
source_attribution.source_path_printed_in_frozen_bibliograp: Historical archival identifier, not a bundled filesystem dependency.
